# AutoParts Century

> Tyre valve manufacturer since 2010 based in Cangzhou, Hebei, China. Rubber snap-in and brass clamp-in valve stems for passenger cars, light trucks, trucks, buses, motorcycles, agricultural machinery and off-road vehicles. OEM/ODM and bulk supply, exporting to 50+ countries.

## Products

- [Passenger Car & Light Truck](https://autopartscentury.com/products/passenger-car-light-truck-valves/): Rubber snap-in and brass clamp-in tyre valves for passenger cars and light trucks: TR412-TR438 snap-in series, TR600HP-TR802HP high-pressure valves, TR416/TR525/VS metal clamp-in valves and PVR153 valve stems.
- [Motorcycle & Bicycle](https://autopartscentury.com/products/motorcycle-bicycle-valves/): PVR series tubeless valves and TR48E colored aluminum alloy valves for motorcycles, scooters and bicycles: PVR30, PVR32 (black/blue/orange anodized), PVR40-PVR70 in 45° and 90° bend options.
- [Truck & Bus](https://autopartscentury.com/products/truck-bus-valves/): V3-20 series, V3.12-V3.19 European style, TR500-TR575, TR570C-TR573C and MS series metal high-pressure clamp-in valves for trucks, buses and heavy-duty commercial vehicles.
- [Agricultural & Off-Road](https://autopartscentury.com/products/agricultural-tractors-off-road-valves/): TR618A, TRJ650-02/03, TR621A-TR623A and TR1175A heavy-duty valves for agricultural machinery and off-road vehicles.
- [Valve Extensions](https://autopartscentury.com/products/valve-extensions/): Metal, hose and plastic tyre valve extensions: EXJ, EX-MT, EXR hose, EX-P plastic and VE36 angled extensions for dual wheels and hard-to-reach valves.
- [Valve Accessories](https://autopartscentury.com/products/valve-accessories/): Tyre valve accessories: plastic, chrome metal and brass valve caps plus standard and high/low temperature resistant valve cores (9001-8002 series) for complete valve service.

## Key Models

- Passenger car: TR412, TR413, TR414, TR415, TR414C (11.5mm / 15.8mm rim holes)
- Motorcycle: PVR40, PVR50, PVR60, PVR70 (45° / 90° bend)
- Truck & bus: V3-20-4, V3-20-6, 58MS, TR570-TR574, TR571C-TR573C, MS70-7 (brass clamp-in)
- Agricultural: TR618A, TRJ650-02/03 large bore swivel, TR1175A
